summary: Moggill Road slip-lane mouth under clearway and no-stopping signs.
reasons: Clearway tow-away and No Stopping signs

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 24 m away and a building 14 m off; open to a busy arterial.
drivers.access_and_room: Line runs along the entry to an exit slip lane with painted chevrons; no room to stop clear of traffic.
drivers.traffic: Moggill Road arterial and its exit lane, constant traffic.
drivers.convention: Clearway tow-away (Mon-Sat 7am-7pm), No Stopping Any Time and Bus Zone signs nearby; no parked cars.

flags: Signs: Clearway tow-away, No Stopping Any Time, Bus Zone
sun_shade: Mostly open to the sky; trees to the east.
